prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a low-speed head-on collision in Baytown, Texas, and has back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1124; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not give my full name on a recording like this, but you can use the claim file.

Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where you were when the collision happened?

A: I was driving on a two-lane road in Baytown, Texas, heading toward the shopping center near the bridge.

Q: What were you doing right before the impact?

A: Traffic had slowed. I was coming up on a curve when a car drifted into my lane. I braked and turned, but we still ended up nose to nose.

Q: How fast do you think you were going?

A: Not fast at all. Maybe twenty-five, thirty miles an hour. It was more of a bump than a crash.

Q: Did either airbag deploy?

A: No. My car's airbags didn't go off, and I didn't hit my head on anything.

Q: Were you able to drive your vehicle from the scene?

A: Yes, it was towed because the front bumper was pushed in, but I got out under my own power.

Q: Tell me about your injuries.

A: My lower back started hurting that evening. It's a tight, pulling pain, worse when I sit for a long time or bend to lift something. I've been taking over-the-counter pain relievers and using a heating pad.

Q: Have you seen a doctor or other medical provider?

A: Yes, I went to urgent care the next morning and they diagnosed a lower back strain. I've also scheduled a follow-up with my regular physician.

Q: Did you have any back problems before this collision?

A: I had some stiffness now and then, but nothing that stopped me from working or doing my normal activities.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I'm trying to get back to normal and I'd appreciate a prompt response on the vehicle repairs and my medical bills.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
